item.title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole over salmonella risk
item.description:
📝 Demian Chavez | ReutersTaylor Farms said on Sunday it was recalling prepared food items containing jalapeños from retailers over concerns about potential salmonella contamination, a few weeks after removing lettuce from Mexico that U. Taylor said it is unaware of any reported illnesses linked to the voluntarily recalled items. Taylor Farms said it voluntarily suspended all iceberg lettuce sourcing and production from central Mexico and commissioned a safety review.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/09/taylor-farms-recalls-salsa-and-guacamole-over-salmonella-risk.html
